pages.text: Heat a water-filled cauldron over a lit campfire. Add ingredients in JEI order and wait: the entire batch boils down to 250 mB of extract. Collect with bottles; draining it leaves an empty cauldron. Sneak-use an empty hand to cancel an unfinished batch and recover inputs. Finished ingredients are spent. Refine bottled Crude Extract in a Brewing Stand with Paper; Aqua Vitae with Sugar Cane makes Clear Base.

Fill the Liquid Blending Bench with carrier bases, optional nicotine, and up to three essences. Each chosen flavor consumes one full essence dose per 250 mB batch. Ingredient bottles return through Glass. Shift-click skips full or incompatible flavor reservoirs. Left-click VG/PG to increase VG; right-click to increase PG. Auto waits for the same flavors when supplies run out.

Insert a blank Liquid Recipe Card and press Save Recipe. It remembers flavors, VG/PG and nicotine. Rename it in an anvil to name bench output. Cards are reusable and optional at the bench; Create blending Basins need one saved card each. Editing selectors starts from the card’s displayed settings and clears its saved formula. Auto keeps the last recipe while waiting for supplies. Trash discards stored essences and stops Auto.

pages.title: Recipe Card Supplies
pages.text: Inserting a saved Recipe Card pulls matching essence bottles from your main inventory and hotbar for one batch, using the selected output bottle size. Essences already stored or queued in the bench count toward the requirement. Existing incompatible flavors stay untouched. Missing ingredients or blocked returned-glass space leave your supplies with you. This happens once when the card is inserted; Auto does not continuously collect bottles from your inventory. Small and normal batches consume one full essence dose per flavor; large batches consume four.

Sneak-use a device to refill or charge. Tanks hold 75 mB for Cigalike, 100 mB for Vape Pen and 150 mB for Box Mod. Redstone adds 20 charge units: half the compact Cigalike cell or 20% of the others. Box Mod has adjustable wattage and a puff counter. Hold use for a longer draw; higher VG gives larger clouds. Pure Vegetable Base bottles can fill an empty vape directly for 100% VG clouds; partially filled tanks need matching contents. Re-dyeing replaces the old color. Wash dye off in a water cauldron.

Create uses heated Mixers and Basins for extraction. Put one saved Recipe Card in each blending Basin. Combine VG and PG first, then nicotine and one essence at a time. A flavor stage consumes a full 250 mB essence dose. Pipe the finished liquid to a Spout for bottling. Cards are reusable.

Small/normal/large bottles hold 150/250/1000 mB. A small bottle fills two empty Cigalikes. Refills use only the amount needed and keep leftover liquid. Pour with a source bottle in the other hand; empty recipients inherit its name, while partial recipients keep their own. Vape liquid works in Tobacco Boxes. Older bottles retain actual contents; old devices above their new tank limit retain all liquid and drain normally before refilling.
